claim_position: Plant-CellFM v9 is a general plant single-cell expression foundation-model and adapter framework with a frozen RTX 4090 LoRA checkpoint, completed v3/centroid/Seurat comparisons, an Arabidopsis root computational biology case, live CUDA service evidence and watchdog recovery evidence.
avoid_claims: universal high-accuracy zero-shot annotation for every plant species
final scPlantLLM or scPlantAnnotate numeric superiority without executable third-party metric evidence

issue_closures.safe_claim: Plant-CellFM v9 improves over frozen v3 on the same shared-gene subset and reports open-set metrics transparently.

issue_closures.issue: third-party comparator panel is not fully closed for every external tool
issue_closures.safe_claim: Completed v3, centroid and Seurat baselines are included; scPlantLLM and scPlantAnnotate are retained as input-ready or access-limited audits.
The Arabidopsis root case demonstrates adapter resolution, annotation, marker-candidate mining and literature-aligned root identity taxonomy on public data.
Snow Lotus is a target-species adapter entry point and extension scenario, not a completed single-cell atlas.

issue_closures.issue: hardware statement changed from early 5090 planning
issue_closures.safe_claim: The v9 submission uses the observed NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090, 24 GB VRAM statement.
The submission branch, release asset, checksum records, live API smoke test and watchdog recovery audit are available for inspection.
